headline: Trump says all mines cleared from Strait of Hormuz
summary: US President Donald Trump said all mines had been cleared from the Strait of Hormuz. Iran had closed the waterway since the start of the conflict, causing wild swings in oil prices.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of global seaborne oil passes, so disruptions move crude prices quickly.
why_moved: Clearance of mines in the strait reduces the risk of a prolonged shipping closure, which had caused wild fluctuations in oil prices.
